output.summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building and shipping production web applications across the stack—from database schema and backend services to React frontends. I take features from idea through production, owning them end to end, and I'm comfortable making the trade-offs between engineering quality and product velocity in a fast-paced environment. My recent work centers on blending AI with intuitive product design: I've shipped production RAG with hybrid retrieval and reranking, prototyped LLM-powered features, and integrated AI-assisted engineering tools into my daily workflow. I collaborate closely with Product and UX, write and review code with care, and communicate clearly in writing and in person. Curious, self-motivated, and biased toward action—I'm excited to help build the next generation of AI-powered tools for the events industry.
